Done. You can now update your remote url for trin with something like:
```
git remote set-url upstream git@github.com:ethereum/trin.git && git fetch upstream
```
Where `upstream` is whatever you called your remote that used to be at `carver/trin`. If you didn't fork the repo, then your remote is probably `origin`. FWIW, we usually favor forking to your own repo, so that the joint repo has a small, clean set of branches.
